exposure: dilation and curettage (D&C) guided by ultrasonography
outcome: Detection of diverticulum in the lower segment of anterior wall of uterus
cohort: 62 patients with cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) who underwent UAE from January 2013 to January 2018
finding: D&C guided by ultrasonography or hysteroscopy for the treatment of CSP after UAE resulted in similarly good clinical outcomes.
